$comment: Known-failing correctness cases: real, reproduced bugs in the tool under test.
They are listed here so `pnpm confirm` can stay a useful gate. A listed
failure does not fail the build; ANY unlisted failure does. Just as
importantly, a listed entry that starts PASSING also fails the build, so a
fixed tool cannot quietly leave a stale suppression behind.
This is not a way to silence inconvenient results. Every entry names the
tool, the observed behaviour, and stays only until the upstream fix lands.
Delete the entry the moment the tool is fixed — the suite will tell you.
compile/v-once/vize: vize emits an unquoted object key in the v-once cache path (`data-testid: "once"`), producing JavaScript that does not parse. Siblings outside v-once quote correctly.
compile/custom-directive/vize: vize omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag for user directives, so the element never enters dynamicChildren and the directive's updated hook never fires. It does emit 512 for built-in v-show.
compile/dynamic-slot-name/vize: vize emits `{ [_ctx.slotName]: ... }` instead of `[slotName.value]`, so a setup-binding slot name never resolves at runtime.
compile/v-once/verter: verter ignores v-once entirely — no _cache / _setBlockTracking wrapper is emitted and the subtree re-renders.
compile/v-text-v-html/verter: verter silently drops v-text and v-html: emits _createElementVNode("span", _hoisted_1) with an empty props object, no textContent/innerHTML, and reports no error.
compile/custom-directive/verter: verter compiles a <script setup> local directive to _resolveDirective("highlight") instead of binding vHighlight, so it fails to resolve at runtime.
compile/css-v-bind/verter: verter double-prefixes useCssVars keys (emits "--a91785dd-x" where runtime-dom then prepends another "--"), so <style> v-bind() never resolves.
compile/v-show/verter: verter omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag for v-show, so toggling the bound value never updates display.
lint/dupe-else-if/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/duplicate-attributes/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/mutating-props/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/mutating-props/vize-lint: no-mutating-props never fires on `props.count += 1` under default, essential, opinionated or ecosystem presets.
lint/deprecated-slot-attr/vize-lint: no-deprecated-slot-attribute never fires on Vue 2 `slot="header"` under any preset.
typecheck/inherit-attrs-false-unknown/ve: verter-tsc unconditionally exempts data-* and aria-* prefixed attributes from strictTemplates undeclared-prop checking (aria-zzz is silent, notdeclared errors), so the planted unknown attribute is missed. Unrelated to inheritAttrs.
typecheck/attrs-aria-data-unknown/verter: Same root cause as above — this case isolates the data-*/aria-* prefix exemption directly.
typecheck/generic-component-ok/verter-ts: verter-tsc emits 3 spurious diagnostics about its own virtual code on a CLEAN generic <script setup> component: ___VERTER___Attrs requires 1 type argument, ___VERTER___attributes is not generic, Cannot find name 'items'.
typecheck/literal-union-prop-bad/vize-ch: vize check reports 0 errors for a STATIC attribute outside its declared string-literal union (variant="danger" against "primary" | "secondary"). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar all catch it. Reproduced deterministically. Same family as the work-gate template prop-type miss (:disabled string→boolean), so vize's strictTemplates prop-type checking on template attributes has real gaps — which is why the typecheck row is bracketed as failed validation rather than ranked.
component-meta/generic-props/vize-declar: vize generateDeclaration emits unparseable TypeScript for generic components — `export type Props<T extends { id: number } = any> = <{ ... }>;` wraps the body in angle brackets (3 TS parse errors). Only generic components are affected.
